name: premium-url-shortener-bot
description: A premium Telegram URL shortener bot built on Cloudflare Workers.

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: A random secret string used to validate incoming Telegram webhook requests.

BITLY_TOKEN.description: Optional. Required only if Bitly is enabled.

CUTTLY_API_KEY.description: Optional. Required only if Cuttly is enabled.

ENABLED_PROVIDERS.description: JSON array or comma-separated list of provider keys to enable.

LINK_DB.description: D1 database used to store pending link selections between Telegram messages and button clicks.
